title: attestation: Prepare measurement register journal
overview: Adds the measurement-register layer to the attestation core: per-instance MR objects built from the provider's fixed MR list, an append-only journal of INFO and EXTEND entries keyed by MR generation, and a prepare/commit scheme for extensions that allocates everything (entry and event) before calling the provider so publication is infallible. mr.c holds journal and MR logic, events.c wraps CTLV event creation and emission, core.c wires MR setup into init/fini, and internal.h declares the shared types. The CTLV operation handlers that consume these helpers arrive in patch 17.

files.purpose: Driver-API document for the attestation subsystem.

units.title: MR journal section
units.summary: Documents that MR extension is transactional: all allocations happen before mr_extend, and publication after success cannot fail.
units.details: Implemented by `attestation_mr_change_prepare()` and `attestation_mr_extend_locked()` in mr.c.

files.purpose: Build rules for the attestation module.

units.title: Add events.o and mr.o
units.summary: Links the new journal and event objects into the attestation module.

files.purpose: Instance registry and lifecycle (from patch 15), here extended to build MR objects at init, allocate the journal at post_init and free both at fini.

units.title: attestation_mr_changed()
units.summary: Bumps the journal generation and the MR read generation after a successful state change.
units.details: Called with `att->lock` held from `attestation_mr_extend_locked()`. `log->generation` is the key of the next journal entry; `mr_read_generation` lets readers detect changes to MR values.

units.title: attestation_mr_alloc()
units.summary: Validates one MR descriptor, rejects duplicate IDs and inserts a new `struct attestation_mr` into `att->mrs`.
units.details: Reuses `attestation_mr_props_validate()` from patch 15. The xarray index is the provider-unique MR id.

units.title: attestation_mr_lookup_live()
units.summary: Looks up an MR by id under the instance lock, returning ERR_PTR(-ENOENT) if absent.
units.details: Intended for the operation handlers in patch 17.

units.title: attestation_provide_ops() - MR operations
units.summary: When the provider has MRs, provides the MR get, dump and log-get operations, plus read and extend only if the provider implements them.

units.title: attestation_core_init() - MR setup
units.summary: Init now initializes the `mrs` xarray and creates an MR object for every provider MR before registering the instance.
units.details: Failure after the lock and xarray init goes to `err_mrs`, which calls `attestation_core_fini()` to free any MRs already created.

units.title: attestation_core_fini() - MR teardown
units.summary: Fini now erases and frees all MR objects, frees the journal and destroys the xarray before the mutex.
units.details: `attestation_mr_log_free()` accepts NULL, so this is safe when post_init never ran.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_post_init() - journal init
units.summary: post_init builds the initial journal before the instance is marked registered; failure leaves the instance unregistered.
units.details: The initial journal holds one INFO entry per MR.

files.purpose: Wrapper around the generated CTLV event helpers for the MR-log notification. It supports a prepare, then emit-or-abort pattern so an event buffer exists before a provider call is made. Used by mr.c.

units.title: attestation_events_prepare() and abort()
units.summary: Creates the entry-appended event context up front (GFP_KERNEL) and aborts it if the operation fails.
units.details: The batch is zeroed on error so abort is idempotent; `ctx` and `reply` are the CTLV event context and its payload cursor.

units.title: attestation_event_finish()
units.summary: Emits the event on success or aborts it on an encoding error, logging failures and clearing the event.
units.details: Emission errors are only logged; they do not undo the committed journal change.

units.title: attestation_mr_log_event_emit()
units.summary: Encodes a journal entry into the prepared event's nested entry attribute and finishes the event.
units.details: Uses `attestation_mr_log_entry_encode()` from mr.c; does nothing if no event was prepared.

files.purpose: Private header for the core. This patch adds the journal, MR and event types and the prototypes for mr.c and events.c.

units.title: Journal entry types
units.summary: Defines the journal: a base entry (generation, MR id, type) embedded in INFO and EXTEND variants, and the log holding entries in an xarray keyed by generation.
units.details: INFO carries a copy of the MR properties; EXTEND carries the digest set that was extended. Variants are recovered with `container_of()`.

units.title: struct attestation changes
units.summary: Adds the MR read generation counter, the `mrs` xarray and the `log` pointer to the instance state.
units.details: All are guarded by `att->lock`.

units.title: MR, event and change types
units.summary: The per-MR object, the prepared event, an event batch, and `struct attestation_mr_change` bundling the MR, a preallocated EXTEND entry and the prepared events.
units.details: A change is built by `attestation_mr_change_prepare()` before the provider is called.

units.title: Prototypes
units.summary: Declarations for core, MR, journal, event and encoding helpers.

files.purpose: MR values, the append-only journal, the transactional extend path and the CTLV encoders for MR properties and journal entries. Callers are the core (init/fini) and the operation handlers in patch 17; it calls the provider's mr_extend and the generated attribute put helpers.

units.title: Includes and attestation_mr_values_validate()
units.summary: Checks that a digest set matches the MR's algorithm list exactly in count and order.

units.title: Digest set copy and free
units.summary: Deep-copies a digest set after checking algorithms are known and strictly ascending; free releases it.
units.details: The copy is stored in an EXTEND entry so the journal does not reference caller memory.

units.title: attestation_mr_info_alloc()
units.summary: Builds an INFO journal entry holding a private copy of the MR's name and algorithm array.
units.details: The copy lets journal entries outlive any provider-owned storage assumptions and be freed independently.

units.title: Journal entry and log free
units.summary: Frees an entry according to its type, and frees a whole log by erasing every entry.
units.details: The type switch mirrors the allocation sites for INFO and EXTEND entries.

units.title: attestation_mr_log_append()
units.summary: Stores an entry at its generation key using a slot reserved earlier.
units.details: GFP_NOWAIT is safe because `attestation_mr_extend_locked()` reserved the slot with `xa_reserve()` first; this is the infallible publication step.

units.title: attestation_mr_log_init()
units.summary: Creates the journal and seeds it with one INFO entry per MR, allocating all entries first and attaching them only when none can fail.
units.details:
- Phase one allocates every INFO entry into a temporary array.
- Phase two assigns increasing generations and inserts them; inserted slots are NULLed in the array so error paths free each entry once.
- Error labels unwind either an attached log or the unattached entries.

units.title: attestation_extend_alloc()
units.summary: Allocates an EXTEND entry and copies the digest values into it.
units.details: Takes the allocation size so the caller supplies the concrete entry struct.

units.title: attestation_mr_change_prepare()
units.summary: First phase of an extend: allocate the change, the EXTEND entry and the prepared event, all before calling the provider.
units.details: Called with `att->lock` held; any failure frees what was allocated and returns an ERR_PTR.

units.title: attestation_mr_extend_locked()
units.summary: Second phase: reserve the journal slot, call the provider's mr_extend, then publish the entry, bump generations and emit the event.
units.details:
- If the generation counter is exhausted, the instance is stopped (`attestation_stop()`) and -EOVERFLOW returned.
- Provider failure releases the reservation; nothing is published.
- On success ownership of the entry moves to the log (`change->entry = NULL`).

units.title: attestation_mr_change_free()
units.summary: Releases a change: aborts any unemitted event and frees an entry that was not published.

units.title: attestation_mr_props_encode()
units.summary: Encodes live MR properties (optional id, name, algorithms, register index, capability bits) into a reply cursor.
units.details: Returns -EMSGSIZE if any put fails. Used by MR get/dump replies in patch 17.

units.title: attestation_values_encode()
units.summary: Encodes each digest as a nested value with its hash algorithm and data bytes.
units.details: Digest length is taken from `hash_digest_size[]`.

units.title: attestation_mr_info_encode()
units.summary: Encodes a copied props struct from an INFO journal entry (name, algorithms, register index, caps).
units.details: Same layout as the props encoder but without the id, since the entry already carries it.

units.title: attestation_mr_log_entry_encode()
units.summary: Encodes a journal entry: generation, MR id, event kind, then INFO properties or EXTEND digest values.
units.details: Used both for journal dump/get replies (patch 17) and for the MR-log notification event.
